methodology: 2015 DPR design evidence transcribed from Chapter 5 tables/text. PDF page is one-based; printed page is the page number shown in the DPR. These facts are proposed design, not present-day as-built or operational status. DPR station keys are deliberately separate from TransitOS current station IDs. Per the TDSE taxonomy, topology fields are in A-network-l2a-line7-records.json and station-structure fields are in B-station-infrastructure-l2a-line7-records.json; this file is the human-readable audit and station schedule.

line2a.notes: §5.3.2 station detail distance conflicts with Table 5.2.1 (printed 6/97, PDF p138), which gives 939.7m. Chainage agrees at 13183.1m.

designStandardsAndCaveats.claim: 17 elevated stations proposed; all elevated stations have two platforms; standard platform length 185m; typical lower concourse and upper platforms; terminal station Dahisar (E) has a special arrangement.
designStandardsAndCaveats.notes: Internal wording conflict: §5.2.2.2 excludes Dahisar terminal from the two-level standard, while §5.3.3.1 says all stations are two-level. §5.3.3.1 separately confirms two platforms at station 1 and describes about 14.5m platform height. The two-tower terminal plan and this conflicting text do not establish a reliable terminal level inventory. Keep its detailed levels unresolved.

designStandardsAndCaveats.claim: 16 elevated stations proposed; typical stations have lower concourse and upper platforms; Dahisar terminal is excepted from standard two-level layout; 185m station length; two platforms at elevated stations.
designStandardsAndCaveats.notes: Station 16 has one unpaid area in the proposal. Two unpaid areas are described for most other stations.

designStandardsAndCaveats.claim: 2031 projected vertical circulation per station: 4 lifts ground-to-concourse and 2 concourse-to-platform; 4 escalators ground-to-concourse and 8 concourse-to-platform. Table 5.3.9 also gives station-specific projected peak boarding/alighting, gate counts and stair width.
designStandardsAndCaveats.notes: Forecast/design provision only, not installed or currently available equipment.

designStandardsAndCaveats.claim: 2031 projected vertical circulation per station: 2 lifts ground-to-concourse and 2 concourse-to-platform; 2 escalators ground-to-concourse and 7 concourse-to-platform. Table 5.3.9 gives station-specific projected peak boarding/alighting, gate counts and stair width.
designStandardsAndCaveats.notes: Forecast/design provision only, not installed or currently available equipment.

designStandardsAndCaveats.claim: Dahisar (E) is proposed integrated with the Dahisar (E)–Andheri corridor, with one platform for each corridor; D. N. Nagar proposed integrated with Line 1 by skywalk; D. N. Nagar station detail describes linked station stairs and a combined structure.
designStandardsAndCaveats.notes: This verifies proposed interchange intent only; transfer path length, paid-area continuity, security arrangement, current wayfinding and current as-built configuration are not established by this evidence.

designStandardsAndCaveats.claim: Andheri (E) proposed connection to Line 1 by elevated walkway; detailed configuration describes the walkway crossing WEH below the Andheri flyover and connecting to Line 1 concourse. Dahisar integration with the Charkop–Dahisar corridor was examined/proposed.
designStandardsAndCaveats.notes: DPR-era connection proposal only; no transfer length or as-built verification in this source.
